feeding_claim.verbatim: Some of these animals will be introduced to a grain diet with free choice hay.

notes: Fifth-generation family farm in Lerna, Coles County, with a farm store open Saturday mornings or by appointment. Checked the homepage, about, products, meet the team and contact pages; the Barn2Door shop could not be fetched. The cow-calf herd rotates on about 200 acres of pasture; after weaning some calves go onto grain with free-choice hay and others stay on grass, and the store lists both 100% grass-fed beef and grass-fed, grain finished beef, so the category is both. Hogs come in as feeder pigs from local farms and eat grain plus pasture and woods forage; chickens are moved on pasture and get some grain. The contact page names delivery to Champaign, Effingham and Mattoon/Charleston and mentions pickup locations listed in the online store, which could not be read. No bulk shares, markets or shipping were found.
